## Please do not disclose vulnerability details here

Do not include exploit steps, secrets, tokens, private keys, connection strings, customer information, repository contents, or sensitive logs in a public issue.

Please close this issue without adding details and report the concern privately through GitHub's Private vulnerability reporting or a private Security Advisory, as described in [`SECURITY.md`](../../SECURITY.md). If private reporting is unavailable, contact the repository maintainers through a private GitHub channel.

This template exists only to redirect reports safely; it is not a substitute for the private process.
